lessons.title: How This Site Checks Quotes
lessons.hook: How can you tell that a quote on a website is really in its source?
lessons.summary: Every quote on this site is copied from its source page, or from the Qara'i translation for Qur'an verses. A checker looks the quote up in the source and it must match word for word. A lesson whose quote does not match stays hidden.

questions.prompt: Put the steps of checking a quote in order.
items: The quote is copied from the source
The checker looks it up in the source
The match must be word for word
A lesson that fails stays hidden
questions.explanation: These are the steps described on the About and Sources pages.

questions.prompt: What happens to a lesson whose quote does not match its source?
options: It is shown with a warning
The quote is edited to fit
questions.explanation: A lesson whose quote fails verification stays hidden, and quotes are never edited to pass.
